page.overview:
Who is Adam Kane?

Adam was able to track down and save Emma DeLauro from Genomex's goons with the help of Shalimar Fox and Jesse Kilmartin. After saving her, they brought her back to their secret mountain base, Stormking Mountain. After explaining the creation of new mutant powers to Emma and offering her a role on the team, Emma initially refused until she was later chased down again by Genomex and saved by the team.
